description: After the money moved: post what was sent and what landed (or the all-in cost) against the map it was chosen from. Returns the expected band beside the realised cost, signed. The outcome is kept by pair and size band only and later maps at that size carry it, so bands tighten and unknowns close. Economics only. Free.

candidate_id_used.description: The candidate_id from the map the payment went through.

map_id.description: The map_id of the Options Map the payment was chosen from.

proof_ref.description: Your own reference for the proof; never an account number.

realised.description: What actually happened: sent_amount and landed_amount, or all_in_bps_vs_ref; with settled_at, and failure if it did not land.

all_in_bps_vs_ref.description: All-in cost against the reference, in basis points (e.g. 85 = 0.85%), when the amounts are not given.

failure.description: true if the payment failed or was returned; default false.

landed_amount.description: Amount that landed, in the map's destination currency, after every deduction.

sent_amount.description: Amount that left, in the map's source currency.

settled_at.description: ISO 8601 date or timestamp the money landed, e.g. '2026-11-04'.

source.description: Where the realised figures come from: bank_mt (bank statement, MT940/950), swift (SWIFT confirmation), onchain_tx (a chain transaction) or manual_upload.

name: reconcile_outcome
title: Reconcile what landed
